task.title: Charging the Kivra Battery
task.shortdesc: Charge the Kivra Battery so that it is fully charged and ready for use.

prereq.p: The ambient temperature is between 10 °C and 30 °C.

step.cmd: Take the Kivra Battery off the bike.
step.info: Use the key and turn it to the left.

step.cmd: Plug the charger into the wall socket.

info.note: Always plug the charger into the wall socket first and connect it to the Kivra Battery second. Do not connect the charger in the reverse order.

step.cmd: Connect the charger to the battery port of the Kivra Battery.
Wait until all 4 LEDs are lit.
step.info: The LEDs show the charging progress. Four LEDs indicate that the Kivra Battery is fully charged. Charging takes around 4-5 hours from empty.

step.cmd: Unplug the charger from the battery port of the Kivra Battery.

info.note: Always unplug the charger from the Kivra Battery first and from the wall socket second.

step.cmd: Unplug the charger from the wall socket.

result.p: The Kivra Battery is fully charged.
